$comment: STATUS-MODEL-01: statusCopy(state, length, audience, { service }) cases. Hand-written wording, no em dashes.

cases.name: adult medium starting
cases.text: Starting up. You can send in a moment.

cases.name: adult long search limited
cases.text: Chat works, but searches may be limited for a while. Answers may use less up-to-date information.

cases.name: teen long paused adds right now
cases.text: Chat is paused right now. Your message stays here; press Send once it is back. It should come back on its own.

cases.name: admin short down has no Repairs link
admin medium paused has the Repairs link
cases.text: Chat is paused. Your message stays here.

cases.name: admin long limited has no Repairs link
cases.text: Chat works, but some features are not available right now.

cases.name: adult long down has no Repairs link
cases.text: Chat is down and will not come back by itself. Your message stays here; press Send once it is fixed.

cases.name: child reads one line at short
cases.text: I'm taking a break. Ask a grown-up, or try again soon.

cases.name: child reads the same line at long
cases.text: I'm taking a break. Ask a grown-up, or try again soon.

cases.name: another service fills the same template
cases.text: Some Library features may be limited.
